records.jp: なるほど、こんな機能もあったのか！
records.en_original: I see. I never knew it had a function like this!
records.en_auxiliary: I see. I never knew it had a function like this!
records.en: I see. I never knew it had a function like this!

records.jp: （ん？　有理の声だ……）
records.en_original: (Hm? That's Yuri's voice...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hm? That's Yuri's voice.)
records.en: (Hm? That's Yuri's voice...)

records.jp: あとこんなのもあるよ。<CR>それから、これとか……
records.en_original: And that's not all you can do. Here, check this out...
records.en_auxiliary: And that's not all you can do. Here, check this out.
records.en: And that's not all you can do. Here, check this out...

records.jp: おお、これも興味深いな……
records.en_original: Wow, this is interesting as well...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, this is interesting, as well.
records.en: Wow, this is interesting as well...

records.jp: 有理？　香織と一緒にいるなんて珍しいね
records.en_original: Yuri? Can't say I expected to find you with Kaori.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri? Can't say I expected to find you with Kaori.
records.en: Yuri? Can't say I expected to find you with Kaori.

records.jp: あ、日菜子じゃん。<CR>日菜子も一緒にゲームやらない？
records.en_original: Ah, Hinako. Wanna join us for a game?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Hinako. Wanna join us for a game?
records.en: Ah, Hinako. Wanna join us for a game?

records.jp: ゲーム？　ああ、スマホの……
records.en_original: A game? Oh, on your smartphone...
records.en_auxiliary: A game? Oh, on your smartphone.
records.en: A game? Oh, on your smartphone...

records.jp: む、これは強敵だな……。<CR>しかし、ここをこうすれば……
records.en_original: Hmm, this is a powerful foe... However, if I do this...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, this is a powerful foe. However, if I do this...
records.en: Hmm, this is a powerful foe... However, if I do this...

records.jp: って有理、すっかりゲームに熱中してる……
records.en_original: That game looks like it really has its hooks in you, Yuri.
records.en_auxiliary: That game looks like it really has its hooks in you, Yuri.
records.en: That game looks like it really has its hooks in you, Yuri.

records.jp: いやー、有理ってあたしとは全然違う世界の人だし、<CR>これまで話したこともなかったんだけどさ
records.en_original: Me and Yuri are basically from different planets, so we never even talked before...
records.en_auxiliary: Me and Yuri are basically from different planets, so we never even talked before.
records.en: Me and Yuri are basically from different planets, so we never even talked before...

records.jp: まさかこんなに話が合うとは思わなかったよ。<CR>驚きだね
records.en_original: But look at us, bonding over something like this! Didn't see that coming.
records.en_auxiliary: But look at us, bonding over something like this! Didn't see that coming.
records.en: But look at us, bonding over something like this! Didn't see that coming.

records.jp: あはは……有理がゲームに熱中してるなんて、<CR>私もちょっとびっくりしたかも
records.en_original: Ahaha... I'm a little surprised to see Yuri so immersed in a game, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... I'm a little surprised to see Yuri so immersed in a game, too.
records.en: Ahaha... I'm a little surprised to see Yuri so immersed in a game, too.

records.jp: ふう……どうにか倒せたぞ
records.en_original: Whew... I managed to defeat it.
records.en_auxiliary: Whew! I managed to defeat it.
records.en: Whew... I managed to defeat it.

records.jp: お、マジ？　やったじゃん！
records.en_original: Whoa, seriously? Nice!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, seriously? Nice!
records.en: Whoa, seriously? Nice!

records.jp: お疲れ様、有理。<CR>やってみてどうだった？
records.en_original: Way to go, Yuri. What did you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Way to go, Yuri. What did you think?
records.en: Way to go, Yuri. What did you think?

records.jp: そうだな……初めはただ確率に左右されるだけのプログラムに<CR>過ぎないと思っていたが、やってみると非常に奥が深い
records.en_original: Well... At first, I thought it was simply a program based on random chance, but there's quite a bit of depth to it.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... At first, I thought it was simply a program based on random chance, but there's quite a bit of depth to it.
records.en: Well... At first, I thought it was simply a program based on random chance, but there's quite a bit of depth to it.

records.jp: サーバーをクラックすれば楽に勝てると<CR>わかってはいるんだが……
records.en_original: Even though I could probably win more easily if I simply hacked the server...
records.en_auxiliary: Even though I could probably win more easily if I simply hacked the server.
records.en: Even though I could probably win more easily if I simply hacked the server...

records.jp: そ、それは絶対やっちゃダメだからね！？
records.en_original: Y-You can't do things like that, okay!?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you can't do things like that, okay?!
records.en: Y-You can't do things like that, okay!?

records.jp: ああ。利用規約に禁止行為とあったから行っていない
records.en_original: I'm aware. I read that it was a prohibited action in the terms of service, so I didn't try.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm aware. I read that it was a prohibited action in the terms of service, so I didn't try.
records.en: I'm aware. I read that it was a prohibited action in the terms of service, so I didn't try.

records.jp: 規約に書いてあるかどうかの問題でもないと思うけど……
records.en_original: It's not so much a question of whether or not it's in the contract...
records.en_auxiliary: It's not so much a question of whether or not it's in the contract...
records.en: It's not so much a question of whether or not it's in the contract...

records.jp: まさか基本料金無料でこれほどの体験ができるとは……。<CR>これほどまで進歩しているとは思わなかった
records.en_original: To think I could experience something like this for free... I never knew games had progressed this far.
records.en_auxiliary: To think I could experience something like this for free. I never knew games had progressed this far.
records.en: To think I could experience something like this for free... I never knew games had progressed this far.

records.jp: まだまだそんなもんじゃないよ。<CR>これ、マルチプレイも対応してるからみんなでも遊べるし
records.en_original: You've even barely scratched the surface. This game has multiplayer, too, so we can all play together!
records.en_auxiliary: You've barely scratched the surface. This game has multiplayer, too, so we can all play together!
records.en: You've even barely scratched the surface. This game has multiplayer, too, so we can all play together!

records.jp: 本当か？　ぜひ、それもやらせてくれ！
records.en_original: Really? I'd very much like to try that!
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I'd very much like to try that!
records.en: Really? I'd very much like to try that!

records.jp: うん、日菜子もいることだし三人でやろうよ。<CR>どのモードにする？
records.en_original: Sure. Since we've got Hinako's here, the three of us can play. What mode do you want to try?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. Since we've got Hinako here, the three of us can play. What mode do you want to try?
records.en: Sure. Since we've got Hinako's here, the three of us can play. What mode do you want to try?

records.jp: ええと……
records.en_original: Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Um...
records.en: Um...

records.jp: 対戦プレイにしない？<CR>敵を一番多く倒した人が勝ちってルールのこれ
records.en_original: How about competitive mode? The one where whoever defeats the most enemies wins.
records.en_auxiliary: How about competitive mode? The one where whoever defeats the most enemies wins.
records.en: How about competitive mode? The one where whoever defeats the most enemies wins.

records.jp: おっけー。<CR>じゃ、日菜子が準備できたらさっそくやろっか
records.en_original: Okay. Let's start as soon as you're ready, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. Let's start as soon as you're ready, Hinako.
records.en: Okay. Let's start as soon as you're ready, Hinako.

records.jp: 結構遊んだね……。<CR>香織には全然勝てなかったなあ
records.en_original: We played quite a bit... Although I could never beat you, Kaori.
records.en_auxiliary: We played quite a bit. Although I could never beat you, Kaori.
records.en: We played quite a bit... Although I could never beat you, Kaori.

records.jp: まあ、ある程度は仕方ないじゃん？　<CR>ゲーム歴が違うし、あたしも最初は弱かったわけだしね
records.en_original: Well, what'd you expect? I've played it way more than you have, and everyone's really weak at first.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, what'd you expect? I've played it way more than you have, and everyone's really weak at first.
records.en: Well, what'd you expect? I've played it way more than you have, and everyone's really weak at first.

records.jp: しかし、その経験の差を埋める工夫を凝らすのは<CR>なかなかやりがいがあったな
records.en_original: Even so, attempting to devise clever ways to try and close that experience gap proved meaningful.
records.en_auxiliary: Even so, attempting to devise clever ways to try and close that experience gap proved meaningful.
records.en: Even so, attempting to devise clever ways to try and close that experience gap proved meaningful.

records.jp: そうだねー。有理、時々あたしと接戦になってたし、<CR>あたしも負けられないって結構ひやひやしてたよ
records.en_original: Right. Sometimes you were pretty close to overtaking me, and I had to put in some real hustle to stay on top.
records.en_auxiliary: Right. Sometimes you were pretty close to overtaking me, and I had to put in some real hustle to stay on top.
records.en: Right. Sometimes you were pretty close to overtaking me, and I had to put in some real hustle to stay on top.

records.jp: ふふ、勝ち負けなんて気にならないくらい楽しかったよね
records.en_original: Hehe. It was really fun though, so winning and losing doesn't matter much.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. It was really fun though, so winning and losing doesn't matter much.
records.en: Hehe. It was really fun though, so winning and losing doesn't matter much.

records.jp: そうだな。会話だけでなく、<CR>ともにゲームをすることで生まれる交流もあるとは……
records.en_original: Agreed. It was fascinating to learn a bit about non-conversational socialization through games, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed. It was fascinating to learn a bit about non-conversational socialization through games, too.
records.en: Agreed. It was fascinating to learn a bit about non-conversational socialization through games, too.

records.jp: うん。有理、素質あると思うし、<CR>また暇があったら一緒にゲームやろうよ
records.en_original: It's a lot of fun. And you've got some real talent, Yuri! Let's play again when you have free time.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a lot of fun. And you've got some real talent, Yuri! Let's play again when you have free time.
records.en: It's a lot of fun. And you've got some real talent, Yuri! Let's play again when you have free time.

records.jp: そうだな。ぜひやらせていただくとしよう
records.en_original: Absolutely.
records.en_auxiliary: Absolutely.
records.en: Absolutely.

records.jp: 協力プレイにしない？<CR>みんなで強い敵を倒すのって楽しそうだし
records.en_original: How about cooperative mode? It would be fun to work together to beat a really strong enemy.
records.en_auxiliary: How about cooperative mode? It would be fun to work together to beat a really strong enemy.
records.en: How about cooperative mode? It would be fun to work together to beat a really strong enemy.

records.jp: お、いいねいいね。<CR>じゃあ、日菜子のスマホにもこのゲーム入れて……と
records.en_original: Sounds good to me! Alright, first of all, let's get the game installed on your smartphone...
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds good to me! All right, first of all, let's get the game installed on your smartphone...
records.en: Sounds good to me! Alright, first of all, let's get the game installed on your smartphone...

records.jp: ……ふう、やっと倒せた！
records.en_original: ...Whew, we finally beat it!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Whew, we finally beat it!
records.en: ...Whew, we finally beat it!

records.jp: お疲れー。<CR>何度もリトライした甲斐があったね
records.en_original: Nice work. All that retrying were did finally paid off.
records.en_auxiliary: Nice work. All that retrying we did finally paid off.
records.en: Nice work. All that retrying were did finally paid off.

records.jp: 驚いたな……プログラム上の敵を倒すことで、<CR>これほどの達成感が得られるとは……
records.en_original: How surprising... To think I'd gain such a sense of accomplishment by simply defeating a programmed foe...
records.en_auxiliary: How surprising. To think I'd gain such a sense of accomplishment by simply defeating a programmed foe.
records.en: How surprising... To think I'd gain such a sense of accomplishment by simply defeating a programmed foe...

records.jp: やっぱり、みんなで頑張って倒せたからかな？<CR>一人でやるのとは違う楽しさがあるし
records.en_original: Maybe it's because we all worked together to beat it? It definitely feels different than just playing alone.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it's because we all worked together to beat it? It definitely feels different than just playing alone.
records.en: Maybe it's because we all worked together to beat it? It definitely feels different than just playing alone.

records.jp: なるほど。複数人でゲームをする……。<CR>それがこの達成感を得る鍵というわけか
records.en_original: I see... Perhaps playing games with multiple people is the key to this feeling of triumph.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, perhaps playing games with multiple people is the key to this feeling of triumph.
records.en: I see... Perhaps playing games with multiple people is the key to this feeling of triumph.

records.jp: こういう交流の仕方もあるとはな。<CR>今後の考察において非常に役立ちそうだ
records.en_original: It's good to know that there are nontraditional ways of socializing. This information should prove valuable.
records.en_auxiliary: It's good to know that there are nontraditional ways of socializing. This information should prove valuable.
records.en: It's good to know that there are nontraditional ways of socializing. This information should prove valuable.

records.jp: んー……難しいこと考えるのもいいけど、<CR>ゲームだしゆるーく遊ぶのがいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Hmm... I mean, I guess you could be all analytical like that, but it is a game. The important thing is having fun!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. I mean, I guess you could be all analytical like that, but it is a game. The important thing is having fun!
records.en: Hmm... I mean, I guess you could be all analytical like that, but it is a game. The important thing is having fun!

records.jp: そうだね。すごく楽しかったし、<CR>また今度やろうよ
records.en_original: That's right. And it was really fun! We should do this again sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. And it was really fun! We should do this again sometime.
records.en: That's right. And it was really fun! We should do this again sometime.

records.jp: ああ、その時はまたよろしく頼む
records.en_original: Yes, I think that would be enjoyable.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I think that would be enjoyable.
records.en: Yes, I think that would be enjoyable.
